verdict.rationale: Wally's integrations docs say one command points a tool at a model and starts it with no manual configuration. The `--cloud` flag is documented for `opencode`, a coding agent, and switches it to the hosted model. The endpoint is OpenAI-compatible, so standard clients work by changing `base_url`, and the same CLI can serve local models offline. Missing for 10: a documented list of supported coding agents beyond opencode, depth on agent-specific setup and tool-calling behaviour through the endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a coding agent working end-to-end.
